info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Logistics Shipments Tracks-v4-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipment Tracking API enables users to monitor the real-time status of their shipments. By providing trackable information, this API facilitates seamless logistics management and enhances operational efficiency. Typical consumers include logistics coordinators, supply chain managers, and business stakeholders seeking visibility into shipment progress. With the ability to query shipment tracks, users can address customer inquiries promptly and optimize delivery processes.

get.summary: Track the status of a shipment.
get.description: Retrieve the current status and details of a shipment using its tracking number. This endpoint allows users to stay updated on the location and estimated delivery time of their packages.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to track shipments. It allows clients to provide necessary tracking information to retrieve the current status and details of their shipments.

200.description: The tracking information was successfully retrieved.

ListLogisticsShipmentsTracksRequest.description: A JSON string representing the request body for the GET operation to track shipments.

status.description: Indicates whether the shipment tracking request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the shipment.

resultId.description: A unique identifier for the result of the tracking operation.

state.description: The current state of the shipment.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the tracking request in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional information or messages regarding the tracking request.

audit.description: Audit information related to the tracking operation.

ListLogisticsShipmentsTracksResponse_200.description: Response schema for the Get Track Operations endpoint, representing the status and details of a shipment tracking request.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the tracking request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the tracking request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the tracking request was generated automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Contains audit information regarding the creation and processing of the tracking operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the total time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
